ingredients.name: Cananga
ingredients.note: Sweet and floral, with a woody, slightly leathery depth.
ingredients.usage: A warm floral heart for white florals, orientals and soap fragrances. It is less heady than ylang ylang and more woody, and it blends well with jasmine, rose and sandalwood.
ingredients.know: Cananga and ylang ylang are two forms of the same tree; cananga flowers give a woodier oil.

ingredients.name: Ylang Ylang
ingredients.note: Intensely floral and creamy, with a sweet, jasmine-like richness.
ingredients.usage: A classic white floral heart in feminine and solar fragrances. It gives creaminess and radiance to jasmine, tuberose and gardenia accords and a soft floral touch to orientals.
ingredients.know: Ylang ylang flowers are picked early in the morning, when their scent is at its strongest.
ingredients.shot: ylang ylang flowers on the branch

ingredients.name: Betel Leaf
ingredients.note: Spicy and phenolic, with a smoky, clove-like green note.
ingredients.usage: A distinctive spicy-green material for oriental, leather and herbal accords. Used sparingly, it adds a smoky, clove-like character with a fresh leafy side.
ingredients.know: Betel leaves, daun sirih, are part of a chewing tradition across Southeast Asia.

ingredients.name: Cajeput
ingredients.note: Fresh and camphoraceous, with a soft, fruity eucalyptus-like note.
ingredients.usage: Brings a cool, clean freshness to aromatic, herbal and functional fragrances, and to balms and wellness products. It pairs with mint, rosemary and citrus.
ingredients.know: Cajeput oil, minyak kayu putih, is a household remedy found in almost every Indonesian home.

ingredients.name: Kaffir Lime Leaf
ingredients.note: Fresh, zesty and green, with a juicy lime-leaf brightness.
ingredients.usage: Gives a sparkling, green citrus lift to colognes, fresh florals and functional fragrances. Its citronellal-rich freshness also suits tropical and aromatic accords.
ingredients.know: In Indonesia kaffir lime is called jeruk purut, and its double-lobed leaf is a staple of local cooking.

ingredients.name: Patchouli
ingredients.note: Rich, earthy and woody, with a dark sweetness that deepens over time.
ingredients.usage: A cornerstone of chypre, woody and oriental fragrances, valued for its depth and its staying power. It anchors a composition, softens sharp edges and pairs especially well with rose, vetiver and resins.
ingredients.know: Patchouli leaves are dried before they are distilled, which helps release their scent.

ingredients.name: Sweet Basil
ingredients.note: Sweet, green and herbal, with a warm anise-like note.
ingredients.usage: Brings an aromatic, anisic freshness to fougères, herbal colognes and green florals, and to savoury and herbal flavours. It pairs well with citrus, lavender and mint.
ingredients.know: This estragole-type basil is the sweet, anise-scented basil of tropical kitchens.

ingredients.name: Tea
ingredients.note: Fresh and green, with a soft, woody and slightly smoky depth.
ingredients.usage: Tea extracts give a calm, natural tea character to fragrance, cosmetic and beverage products. Green tea brings freshness and transparency, black tea a deeper woody warmth.
ingredients.know: Green and black tea come from the same leaves; black tea is fully oxidised before it is dried.

ingredients.name: Citronella Java
ingredients.note: Fresh, lemony and grassy, with a soft rosy undertone.
ingredients.usage: Used for fresh, clean effects in functional and household fragrances, soaps and candles. Its blend of citronellal and geraniol gives both citrus freshness and a rosy heart.
ingredients.know: Java-type citronella is valued for its high citronellal and geraniol content.

ingredients.name: Lemongrass
ingredients.note: Bright, lemony and grassy, with a sharp fresh lift.
ingredients.usage: A natural source of citral for fresh citrus, herbal and functional fragrances. It brings vitality to colognes, soaps and home fragrance and pairs well with ginger and green notes.
ingredients.know: Lemongrass is called serai in Indonesia and grows in clumps of tall, fragrant blades.

ingredients.name: Palmarosa
ingredients.note: Sweet, rosy and fresh, with a soft green grassy edge.
ingredients.usage: A natural rose note rich in geraniol, used to brighten rose and geranium accords, fresh florals and soaps. It brings a clean floral sweetness to colognes and household fragrances.
ingredients.know: Palmarosa is a grass, yet its oil smells strongly of rose.

ingredients.name: Black Pepper
ingredients.note: Fresh, dry and peppery, with a woody, slightly citrus sparkle.
ingredients.usage: A modern favourite for adding fresh spice to woody, aromatic and citrus fragrances. It gives an energetic, dry lift to the top of a composition and pairs naturally with vetiver, cedar and grapefruit.
ingredients.know: Black pepper is the whole dried berry of a climbing vine; picked green, it darkens as it dries in the sun.

ingredients.name: Clove
ingredients.note: Warm, rich and spicy, instantly recognisable.
ingredients.usage: Brings a spicy accent to floral, oriental and woody accords, carnation notes above all. In small amounts it warms rose and other florals, and in larger ones it gives a bold, festive spice to ambers and woods.
ingredients.know: Cloves are the dried flower buds of a tree native to the Maluku Islands of Indonesia.

ingredients.name: Cubeb
ingredients.note: Spicy and woody, with a cool, camphoraceous pepper note.
ingredients.usage: Brings a cool, woody pepper to aromatic, woody and oriental fragrances. It adds dryness and texture to the top and heart, and works well with incense, cardamom and woods.
ingredients.know: Cubeb is known as tailed pepper: each dried berry keeps a small stalk.

ingredients.name: Fenugreek
ingredients.note: Sweet and caramel-like, with a warm, herbaceous, maple-like depth.
ingredients.usage: Used in tiny amounts for gourmand, tobacco and ambery effects, where it brings a natural maple and caramel warmth. It also deepens immortelle, hay and lovage notes.
ingredients.know: Fenugreek seeds owe their maple-like scent to sotolon, which is also found in maple syrup.

ingredients.name: Nutmeg & Mace
ingredients.note: A fresh, aromatic spice with a warm, gently sweet heart.
ingredients.usage: Lifts the opening of woody, aromatic and spicy fragrances with a lively, natural warmth. It pairs well with citrus, lavender and woods, and mace adds a softer, slightly floral side to the same note.
ingredients.know: Nutmeg is the seed and mace the red aril around it: two spices from one fruit, native to the Banda Islands.

ingredients.name: White Pepper
ingredients.note: Warm and peppery, rounder than black pepper, with a faint animalic depth.
ingredients.usage: Gives a warm, softer spice to woody, leathery and oriental fragrances. Its rounded character blends easily into the heart, where it supports florals and woods without the sharpness of black pepper.
ingredients.know: White pepper comes from the same vine as black pepper: ripe berries are soaked and their outer skin removed.

ingredients.name: Benzoin Sumatra
ingredients.note: A warm, balsamic resin with sweet, vanilla-like and softly spicy facets.
ingredients.usage: Brings warmth and roundness to amber, oriental and floral accords, and helps a fragrance last on the skin. Its soft vanilla facets blend naturally with woods, spices and balsams, and a small touch gives depth to the base of almost any composition.
ingredients.know: Benzoin is the resin of the Styrax tree, known in Indonesia as kemenyan.

ingredients.name: Gurjun Balsam
ingredients.note: A soft, woody balsam with a faintly peppery, ambery warmth.
ingredients.usage: Used as a smooth woody fixative in ambers, woods and fougères, where it rounds off sharper materials. Its quiet character lets it carry other notes rather than lead, and it is a practical base for woody accords.
ingredients.know: Gurjun balsam is tapped from tall dipterocarp trees, the giants of the Southeast Asian rainforest.

ingredients.name: Cinnamon Kerinci
ingredients.note: Warm, sweet and spicy, with all the comfort of cinnamon bark.
ingredients.usage: Adds warmth and vibrancy to spicy, oriental and gourmand compositions. Used with restraint, it lifts the heart of a fragrance and gives a comforting sweetness to ambers and woods.
ingredients.know: This cinnamon takes its name from Kerinci, a highland region known for its cinnamon trees.

ingredients.name: Massoia
ingredients.note: Creamy and milky, with a natural coconut-like lactone sweetness.
ingredients.usage: A natural source of creamy lactonic notes for gourmand, tropical and solar fragrances, and for coconut and dairy flavours. A little adds softness and a skin-like warmth to florals such as tuberose and gardenia.
ingredients.know: Massoia bark owes its creamy scent to massoia lactone, a natural lactone also found in coconut.

ingredients.name: Rhubarb
ingredients.note: Earthy and slightly bitter, with a green, rooty depth.
ingredients.usage: Used in cosmetic and botanical preparations for its rooty, earthy character. In fragrance it suggests a green, tart and earthy note alongside fruity accords.
ingredients.know: Medicinal rhubarb is grown for its thick root rather than for its stalks.

ingredients.name: Vetiver Java
ingredients.note: Deep, woody and earthy, with a dry, smoky edge.
ingredients.usage: Gives structure and elegance to woody, aromatic and chypre fragrances. Its dry, rooty depth works as a backbone in masculine compositions and brings a cool, earthy freshness to modern florals and citrus.
ingredients.know: Vetiver is a grass, but its scent lies in its roots.

ingredients.name: Ginger
ingredients.note: Fresh and spicy, with a warm, lemony and woody bite.
ingredients.usage: Adds a lively spice to citrus, woody and oriental fragrances and is essential in ginger flavours. Fresh ginger oil keeps the zesty top of the root, while extracts carry its pungent warmth.
ingredients.know: Ginger is a rhizome, an underground stem, not a root.

ingredients.name: Homalomena
ingredients.note: Fresh and floral, with a soft spicy, herbaceous lift.
ingredients.usage: Brings a fresh, linalool-rich floral note to herbal, citrus and lavender accords. It works well as a natural lift in colognes and in fresh florals that need a green, spicy edge.
ingredients.know: Homalomena is a forest aroid whose aromatic rhizome has long been used in traditional remedies.

ingredients.name: Kencur
ingredients.note: Spicy and camphoraceous, with an earthy, slightly balsamic warmth.
ingredients.usage: An unusual spicy note for oriental, woody and herbal accords, and a key ingredient in traditional Indonesian wellness drinks. Its extracts are also used in cosmetics.
ingredients.know: Kencur is the aromatic ginger behind beras kencur, a traditional Javanese rice drink.

ingredients.name: Red Ginger
ingredients.note: Warm and pungent, spicier and earthier than common ginger.
ingredients.usage: Brings a deeper, warmer ginger to spicy and oriental fragrances, and to wellness and herbal products. It is a natural choice where a bold, warming ginger character is needed.
ingredients.know: Red ginger, jahe merah, is smaller than common ginger and has a reddish skin.

ingredients.name: Temulawak
ingredients.note: Herbal and spicy, with a warm, earthy, slightly bitter note.
ingredients.usage: Known as Java turmeric, it is valued in cosmetic and wellness products and brings a warm herbal spice to fragrance. Its key component is xanthorrhizol.
ingredients.know: Temulawak is native to Java and is a core ingredient of jamu, traditional Indonesian herbal medicine.

ingredients.name: Turmeric
ingredients.note: Warm, earthy and spicy, with a fresh woody note.
ingredients.usage: Brings a warm, earthy spice to woody and oriental fragrances and is widely used in cosmetic and wellness products. Its CO2 extract keeps the aromatic turmerones of the fresh root.
ingredients.know: Turmeric root is bright orange inside, the source of its golden colour.

ingredients.name: Cocoa
ingredients.note: Rich and chocolatey, with a bitter, roasted depth.
ingredients.usage: A natural chocolate note for gourmand fragrances and for flavours. It deepens ambers, tobacco and vanilla accords with a dry, roasted sweetness.
ingredients.know: Cocoa beans develop their chocolate aroma only after fermentation and roasting.

ingredients.name: Coffee Arabica
ingredients.note: Roasted and aromatic, with a soft fruity, chocolatey note.
ingredients.usage: A natural coffee note for gourmand and woody fragrances and for flavours. Arabica gives a smoother, more aromatic coffee than robusta.
ingredients.know: Arabica grows at higher altitude than robusta and ripens more slowly.
ingredients.shot: ripe coffee cherries on the branch

ingredients.name: Coffee Robusta
ingredients.note: Bold, roasted and smoky, with a nutty bitterness.
ingredients.usage: A strong natural coffee note for gourmand, tobacco and woody fragrances and for flavours. Robusta brings more body and bitterness than arabica.
ingredients.know: Indonesia is one of the largest robusta producers in the world.

ingredients.name: Tamarind
ingredients.note: Sweet and sour, with a dark, date-like fruitiness.
ingredients.usage: Used in flavours, beverages and cosmetic preparations for its tangy fruit character. In fragrance it suggests a dark, sweet-sour fruit note.
ingredients.know: Tamarind, asam jawa, is a pod fruit whose sticky pulp is both sweet and sour.
